load_mistral_config: load and parse a Mistral model config from a local or HuggingFace model path
adapt_config_dict: adapt a Mistral-style config dict into a HuggingFace PretrainedConfig with proper remapping
parse_mistral_config: parse a Mistral params.json config file and return a HuggingFace-compatible config dict and config object
is_mistral_model: test whether a model name refers to a Mistral model needing the custom config parser
patch_mistral_common_tokenizer: patch a MistralCommon tokenizer to be compatible with the HuggingFace tokenizer API
